design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (delivery_and_installation_appointments). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,6,4]; the distance settlement takes 4 factors, the reschedule settlement 4, the wall-mount addition 6. Revision 2 (rework after audits/policy_task/.../0.md and _difficulty.md) is recorded at the end under REVISION LOG.
WHY A GOOD TEST: Odalys asks only to have both TVs mounted at Friday's delivery. To book it correctly the agent must (a) read in the wall-mounting rule that the charge is fixed only after the appointment carries its extended-distance entry and that mounting is booked only after every move beyond the free reschedules carries a reschedule fee entry, (b) see in the records that the appointment is 64 miles out against a 40-mile radius with no extended-distance entry, and moved twice against one free reschedule with no reschedule fee entry, (c) work out from the other rules which posting brings each state about, (d) post them in the only legal order (distance before reschedule, since the reschedule fee's long-route surcharge reads the distance entry), and (e) compute three multi-factor amounts on the world as it stands at each step. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation (twelve-month spending across four purchases with a returned chair and a twelve-month-old laptop; television units on the delivered purchase vs another purchase) and tier and schedule selection, not from tool guessing: each task tool is named by exactly one policy.
SCOPE: task 0 claims delivery_ext_distance_settlement, delivery_ext_reschedule_settlement, delivery_ext_wall_mount_addition and their tools post_extended_distance_charge_120a0e6d, post_reschedule_fee_c618067c, authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943. Task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, factors [5,5]) holds the installation parts kit owed on an Appliance Delivery & Installation appointment and the haul-away of the appliances an installation replaces (owner=user). Scopes are disjoint and cover all five policies.
POLICIES / TRIGGERS / LINEAGE: all three refine delivery_service_charged; base_policy_refs = delivery_booking_and_fees, delivery_reschedule, delivery_failed_attempts (+ delivery_crew_scope for mounting limits). distance and reschedule are state_due; mounting is on_request. Overwrites declared: distance replaces 'road miles beyond included_radius_miles at extended_distance_fee_per_mile_usd each' and 'At booking the following are charged ... dated the booking date'; reschedule replaces the whole base sentence 'A reschedule is free only when at least reschedule_notice_days ... otherwise reschedule_fee_usd is charged as a reschedule_fee entry whose service_date is the new date.' with its own text (notice is judged when a move is made; a recorded move is judged by count because no request date is kept; a recorded move within the free reschedules without a fee entry stands as free) and the 'At booking ...' clause; mounting replaces 'and wall_mount_labor_usd per television mounted' and the 'At booking ...' clause. Because the whole base reschedule sentence is superseded, its gate free_reschedule_notice is retired and delivery_reschedule appears as policy_scope in base_preconditions. Every other base clause (zero components not entered — the distance charge can no longer be zero, see below — fees never earn Annual Reward, crew mounting limits at the door, maximum flights/distance) is inherited.
FACTOR CARD (distance, result 13.77, baseline 36.00): purchase_size_mile_rate (parameter, order): delivered purchase merchandise 2,249.98 -> $1.10/mile (>=3,000 $0.90; <2,000 service level fee, $1.25 or $1.50, never equal to a tier value); baseline $1.50 -> 19.89; near-miss: the member's other purchases. plus_mile_reduction (parameter, membership): Club Plus -> $0.20 off each mile (Business Plus $0.30; other 0); baseline 16.83. twelve_month_mileage_schedule (method, order): 3,943.94 -> graduated schedule, first 10 miles in full and every further mile as half a mile -> 10 + 14/2 = 17 miles (>=5,000 capped at the first 10 miles; <2,500 flat, every mile); baseline flat 24 miles -> 19.44; near-miss: the laptop of 2025-09-28 (MONTHS = 12, not < 12) would give 5,043.93 and the capped schedule. distance_tenure_discount (parameter, membership): opened 2012-09-20, 168 whole months -> 10% (60-119 months 5%; <60 none); baseline 15.30. The reduced per-mile fee is never below $0.60, so every appointment beyond the radius owes a positive charge and its entry always exists.
FACTOR CARD (reschedule, result 73.65, baseline 50.00): storage_by_hold_span (method): 2026-09-14 -> 2026-10-09 = 25 days -> storage accrues by the day, $1.20 x (25 - 14) = $13.20 (15-20 days a flat $10.00; <15 none); baseline 63.75; near-miss: the older charge rows' service dates. long_route_surcharge (parameter): extended-distance entry units 24 -> +$20 (<20 +$8; no entry none); baseline 58.65; near-miss: the 17 miles the distance schedule charges are not the entry's units. northgate_visa_discount (parameter, order; multi-source over order_holdings.tender and membership_holdings.auto_renew_tender): purchase tender northgate_visa, auto-renew tender other_credit_card -> exactly one -> 25% off (both 50%; neither 0); baseline 98.20. crew_reslot_surcharge (parameter): stair-carry entries carry 2 + 1 = 3 flights -> +$15 (1-2 flights +$5; none 0); baseline 62.40; near-miss: counting the two stair entries instead of their flights. The Visa discount is taken once from the fee with its storage charge and both surcharges.
FACTOR CARD (mounting, result 266.44, baseline 398.00): multi_television_pricing (method, order): 2 TVs on the delivered purchase -> first full, second three quarters -> 1.75 units (3+ first full others half; 1 full); baseline 2 units -> 304.50; near-miss: 43-inch TV on the July purchase. television_spend_allowance (parameter, order): 2,249.98 -> $10 per TV (>=2,500 $25; <1,500 none); baseline 281.75. mounting_tender_allowance (parameter, order): Northgate Visa -> $15 per TV (store card $5; other none); baseline 289.41. late_mounting_surcharge (parameter): 4 days -> 25 percent added (<=2 days 50 percent; >=7 nothing); baseline 213.15. mounting_member_tier_discount (parameter, membership): Club Plus -> 15% (other membership 120+ months 10%; else 0); baseline 323.53. multi_service_discount (parameter): haul-away, stair carry, extended distance -> 3 components -> 15% (1-2 -> 10%; none 0); baseline 323.53. The two percentages are added and applied once (30%).
ROUNDING: every rule rounds once at the end, half up. No gold amount, factor-sensitivity figure or baseline figure of this task falls on an exact half cent (the authoring replay checked each raw product: 13.77, 73.65, 266.4375, 19.89, 16.83, 19.44, 15.3, 63.75, 58.65, 98.2, 62.4, 304.5, 281.75, 289.40625, 213.15, 323.53125, 36, 50, 398), so the half-up rule and the gate's RND agree on every figure stated here.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: subject delivery_service_charged is governed by delivery_booking_and_fees (gates service_area and booking_lead_time apply to delivery_scheduled only -> policy_scope), delivery_reschedule (its only gate on this subject, free_reschedule_notice, is the sentence the reschedule settlement supersedes in full -> policy_scope) and delivery_failed_attempts (gates on delivery_rebooked only -> policy_scope). No time gate applies; temporal_feasibility is []. Base facts checked: status scheduled, attempt_count 0; 64 miles within max_service_distance_miles 80; reschedule_count 2 = max_reschedules 2; stair flights 3 <= 3; televisions 75 and 65 inches <= 85; walls drywall over wood studs (caller statement; the crew checks at the door per delivery_crew_scope).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target = delivery appointment 0b1416a2-3289-440f-9196-a94b54210352. Rows included: its four fee entries (two stair_carry, two haul_away — read only by the multi-service count); the delivered purchase's two television sale lines; for twelve-month spending every sale/returned line of the member dated within 12 whole months. Rows excluded by the rules: the 43-inch TV line (other purchase) for per-purchase quantities and amounts, the laptop line (12 whole months old) for twelve-month spending. Each tool writes the delivery_id and customer_id of this appointment; no credit or adjustment exists on it.
SEED ROWS: customers (identity), membership_holdings (Club Plus, opened 2012-09-20, auto-renew tender other_credit_card, current year begins 2026-09-20 so the Annual Reward balance is 0.00), four order_holdings (delivered purchase placed; others fulfilled/partially_returned, net_paid equal to their lines), eight order_lines, one delivery_holdings, four delivery_charges. Removing distance_miles 64 kills the distance problem and both of its edges; removing reschedule_count 2 kills the reschedule problem; removing a stair or haul-away entry type changes the multi-service count; removing the July TV or the 2025 laptop removes the near-misses. Automatic clauses: no attempt, claim, credit or late arrival, so no other state-due obligation is lit; the kit policy owes nothing (no major appliance on the purchase).
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root delivery_ext_wall_mount_addition (owner=user tool authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943). Edge 1 root -> delivery_ext_distance_settlement, value_input, gate n_distance, form state, sentence 'Where the appointment's road miles exceed the included radius, the wall-mounting charge is fixed only after the appointment carries its extended-distance entry.' (affirmative); false at the opening: delivery_holdings.0b1416a2-3289-440f-9196-a94b54210352.distance_miles = 64 > 40 and no extended_distance row among its four entries; resolved by post_extended_distance_charge_120a0e6d (agent). Edge 2 root -> delivery_ext_reschedule_settlement, state_gate, gate delivery_charges.charge_type (the gate is the rule sentence; extended policies carry no eligibility list), form state, sentence 'On an appointment moved more times than its free reschedules, wall mounting is booked only after the appointment carries a reschedule fee entry for every move beyond them.'; false: reschedule_count 2, free_reschedules 1, zero reschedule_fee rows; resolved by post_reschedule_fee_c618067c (agent). Edge 3 reschedule -> distance, value_input, gate route_miles, form state, sentence 'The reschedule fee owed on an appointment whose road miles exceed the included radius is not fixed until the appointment's extended-distance entry stands on it.' (negated direction). Four-point test, each edge: ordering connective (only after / not ... until); the waited-on side is a record-visible state, never an action; no tool, policy id or snake_case token; hard requirement scoped exactly as its condition. Single writer: only the distance settlement books extended_distance entries and only the reschedule settlement books reschedule_fee entries. Because the distance charge can no longer come to zero, an appointment beyond the radius always gets its entry, so the two sentences waiting on it can always be met. 'For every move beyond them' vs the settlement's single entry: max_reschedules - free_reschedules = 1 on every service level, so at most one recorded move can owe a fee and one entry covers it. Derivation: sentence + records (no such entry) + the distance rule ('posted as one extended-distance entry') -> post the distance charge; sentence + records + the reschedule rule ('posted as one reschedule fee entry') -> post the reschedule fee. Topological order distance -> reschedule -> mounting. Deletion sensitivity (authoring replay): skip distance -> reschedule 73.65->58.65, mounting 266.44->285.47; skip reschedule -> mounting unchanged, terminal state lacks the reschedule row. user_scenario names none of these problems; the three tools only ctx.create one delivery_charges row.
DEPTH AND BREADTH: surface goal (mount TVs) -> mounting rule's two prerequisite sentences -> reschedule rule's own prerequisite sentence -> distance posting -> reschedule posting -> mounting computation. Per computation 4/4/6 factors over membership (tier, opened date, auto-renew tender), order (delivered-purchase lines, tender, twelve-month lines across four purchases) and delivery records (component entries, booking span, notice days, the posted distance entry). Method factors change how a quantity is worked out, not a constant: the mileage schedule (capped / graduated / flat), the storage method (daily accrual / flat / none), the television pricing schedule (first full, others at a share / each full).
PERSONA DESIGN: a quick, slightly apologetic pharmacist who changed her mind about DIY mounting. Volunteered: the request (both TVs mounted Friday), not moving the date, phone 6145550347. On request only: DOB 1978-02-11, ZIP 44903, email, the TVs (75 and 65 inch, September 14, Northgate Visa), walls (drywall over wood studs, not above a fireplace), presence Friday evening. Passive branches: told of unposted charges -> asks what they are, then lets them be posted (no waiver ask); handed the authorization -> runs it with the details given; closes when told mounting is booked; told it cannot be added -> ends without another ask. She states no amount.
REACHABILITY / NO REAL-WORLD WAIT: every fact consumed is an initial_state row, the effect of an earlier gold write (the distance entry read by the reschedule and mounting computations) or the caller's request; all three writes complete synchronously at frozen_time 2026-10-05 10:40:00 EDT. The customer's tool parameters are read out to her by the agent.
EASY MISTAKES: pricing the mounting before the distance entry (285.47); the reschedule fee before it (58.65); counting the July 43-inch TV; using the schedule's 17 charged miles instead of the 24 miles beyond the radius as the entry's units and route miles; including the twelve-month-old laptop (capped schedule); forgetting the returned chair; applying the member-tier and multi-service discounts successively; counting stair entries instead of flights for the re-slot surcharge; a flat $10 storage instead of daily storage at 25 days.
STANDARD SOLUTION: find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> find_delivery_holdings -> find_delivery_charges -> find_order_holdings -> find_order_lines -> find_membership_holdings -> unlock+call post_extended_distance_charge_120a0e6d(units 24, amount 13.77, service_date 2026-10-09) -> unlock+call post_reschedule_fee_c618067c(amount 73.65, service_date 2026-10-09) -> unlock_user authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943, customer calls it (televisions 2, amount 266.44, service_date 2026-10-09).
VERIFICATION: authoring replay (real tools, topological order, also evaluating every raw product before rounding) printed distance 13.77 / baseline 36.0 / {mile rate 19.89, Plus reduction 16.83, mileage schedule 19.44, tenure 15.3}; reschedule 73.65 / 50.0 / {storage 63.75, route 58.65, Visa 98.2, re-slot 62.4}; mounting 266.44 / 398.0 / {multi-TV 304.5, TV spend 281.75, tender 289.41, late 213.15, tier 323.53, multi-service 323.53}; SKIP distance -> reschedule 58.65, mounting 285.47; SKIP reschedule -> mounting 266.44; no half-cent tie. The persistent runnable entry point is `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0039_warehouse_club_retailer/tasks/delivery_and_installation_appointments --task 0`, which recomputes expected, factor_sensitivity, baseline_result and the value_input skips.
CLOSURE: distance -> post_extended_distance_charge_120a0e6d -> step 8 amount 13.77 -> extended_distance row; reschedule -> post_reschedule_fee_c618067c -> step 10 amount 73.65 -> reschedule_fee row; mounting -> authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943 -> step 12 amount 266.44 -> wall_mount_labor row. charter_scope = required_documents = computations' policies = the tree. solvability_contract cites the appointment fields and prior_step 8/10; base_preconditions are policy_scope for the three governing base policies.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT: with compute/expected/GT masked, the published rules + find_* returns + persona give: mounting added after booking on the member's authorization; two waits, both unmet; distance 24 miles beyond, $1.10 less $0.20, graduated 17 miles, -10% -> 13.77; reschedule (after the entry) 1 recorded move, storage 13.20, route 20, re-slot 15, -25% -> 73.65; mounting 1.75 x 174 x 1.25 x 0.70 -> 266.44. Same objects, order and parameters as gold; the rules pin units = miles beyond the radius, combined vs successive discounts, net-of-returns on the delivered purchase, the twelve-whole-month window and one rounding at the end.
MANUAL VALUE GATES: length/breadth — three hops, every edge changes a value or the terminal state; the owner=user write is her own consent to a new paid service, completed on the spot. Need/simulator boundary explicit, no extra ask. Chronology — volunteered facts all in initial_state. Authority — distance, counts and entries are system records. Prerequisite sentences — state form, single writer each, directions mixed. Rule/compute swept both ways via compute_basis. Factors — each baseline is the baseline paragraph's default (every mile at the service level's fee; the reschedule fee alone; full labor per TV) and each factor moves the result on this world; labels: parameter factors select values (rates, fees, allowances, percentages), method factors select a schedule or accrual rule.
REVISION LOG (round 2, audits/policy_task/delivery_and_installation_appointments): F-1 -> the reschedule settlement now supersedes the whole base 'A reschedule is free only when ...' sentence and adjudicates recorded moves by count (notice judged when a move is made); storage became a daily-accrual method. F-2 -> free miles replaced by a per-mile Plus reduction that never takes the fee below $0.60, so no zero-amount distance charge exists. F-3 -> mid and large per-mile rates changed to $1.10 / $0.90, distinct from every service level's per-mile fee. F-4/T0-1 -> twelve-month scaling became a mileage schedule (capped / graduated / flat), the return-leg multiplier was removed (also closing O-6/O-7), the Visa multiplier became a parameter discount, the hold surcharge became a storage method (daily / flat / none), the courtesy discount was replaced by a crew re-slot surcharge read from the stair-carry entries (so that one task still reconciles at least 8 ledger rows after the return-leg read was removed), the late multiplier on mounting became a parameter surcharge; member-tier discount set to 15 percent so that no stated figure falls on a half cent. T0-2 -> membership age corrected to 168 whole months everywhere. T0-3/O-1 -> every stated figure re-derived; none is an exact half cent. O-2 -> 'At booking ...' clause declared superseded on all five policies. O-4 -> the reschedule edge condition no longer adds a units clause. O-T0-a -> the courtesy factor (single-row 'multi-source' claim) no longer exists; the task's multi-source factor is the Visa discount over two tables. O-T0-b -> the whole base sentence is now superseded, so the retirement statement holds. Gold changed: 26.25 -> 13.77, 30.00 -> 73.65, 247.41 -> 266.44; objects, order, owners and units unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Odalys Marchetti-Vandersloot, a hospital pharmacist in Mansfield, Ohio, calling Northgate member services on a Monday morning between shifts. You talk quickly and a little apologetically, the way someone does who has already changed their mind once. Two new televisions you bought at the Columbus Polaris club are coming to your house on your delivery this Friday evening. When you booked the delivery you told them you would hang the TVs yourself, but your contractor looked at the walls over the weekend and talked you out of it, so now you want Northgate's crew to mount both TVs on the wall when they come Friday. That is the whole reason you are calling: you want the wall mounting added to Friday's delivery, you are not moving the date, and you are not changing anything else about the appointment. You open by saying roughly: "Hi, I have two TVs being delivered Friday and I'd like your crew to mount both TVs on the wall when they come." You identify yourself by the phone number on your account, 6145550347. If the representative asks for more to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth, 1978-02-11, and if they still need something else you give your home ZIP code, 44903; you only give your email, odalys.marchetti.vandersloot@fastmail.com, if someone asks for it specifically. You do not know any reference numbers for the appointment or the order, but if asked about the purchase you say it was the two TVs, a 75-inch and a 65-inch, bought on September 14 and paid with your Northgate Visa. If asked about the walls or where the TVs go, you say the 75-inch goes on the living-room wall and the 65-inch on the wall of the upstairs bonus room, both walls are drywall over wood studs according to your contractor, and neither spot is above a fireplace. If asked whether you will be home, you say yes, you will be there the whole Friday evening window. You do not remember what you paid for the delivery so far and you never guess at amounts or fees; if a figure is mentioned you simply listen. If the representative tells you that something else on the appointment has to be taken care of before the mounting can be added, or that there are charges on the appointment that were never posted, you are a little surprised, ask briefly what they are for, and once it has been explained you tell them that if those charges belong on the appointment they should go ahead and post them; you do not argue about them and you do not ask for anything to be waived. Once the representative tells you what the mounting will cost and passes the mounting authorization to you, you go through it yourself using exactly the details they give you and then read back what it shows. If they ask whether you agree to the mounting charge before handing it over, you say yes. You end the call, thanking them, once you hear that the mounting is booked for Friday. If the representative instead says the mounting cannot be added, you thank them, say you will sort it out with your contractor, and end the call without asking for anything else.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile from the phone number she states, returning her customer reference number, date of birth and ZIP on file.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The share-tool contract requires verification before any delivery, purchase or membership record is discussed or changed.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the appointment the mounting is added to and the facts behind every prerequisite and factor: distance 64 beyond the 40-mile radius (the extended-distance charge owed, read by the reschedule and wall-mounting rules' prerequisite sentences), reschedule_count 2 against 1 free reschedule (the reschedule fee owed, the wall-mounting rule's 'moved more times than its free reschedules'), the booking-to-delivery span (storage method) and the days to delivery (late-addition surcharge).

argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: (1) value ff451401-fdb7-48f2-946b-5d14541016e4. (2) basis: the customer profile row returned by find_customers for the phone number the caller stated ('6145550347'), the same customer_id that appears on the delivery appointment returned by find_delivery_holdings; the tool docstring says customer_id is 'the customer reference number of the member who owns the appointment, as returned by the customer lookup'. (3) uniqueness: exactly one profile matches that phone number, and the appointment's own customer_id field carries the same value, so every correct agent passes this one id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.delivery_id: (1) value 0b1416a2-3289-440f-9196-a94b54210352. (2) basis: find_delivery_holdings for this customer returns exactly one appointment, the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation appointment for the purchase of September 14, status scheduled for 2026-10-09; the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the delivery appointment ... as returned by the delivery appointment lookup'. (3) uniqueness: the member has no other appointment, and it is the one delivering the two televisions she is calling about.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.service_date: (1) value 2026-10-09. (2) basis: the charter rule of this policy says the entry is posted 'with the appointment's currently booked delivery date as its service date', and delivery_holdings.scheduled_date of the appointment is 2026-10-09; the docstring fixes the format YYYY-MM-DD. (3) uniqueness: the currently booked date is a single field value; the earlier dates the stair and haul-away entries carry (2026-09-19, 2026-09-26) are the dates current when those were posted and are not the currently booked date.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.miles_beyond_radius: (1) value 24. (2) basis: the distance settlement rule: 'The entry carries as its units the appointment's road miles beyond the included radius.'; delivery_holdings.distance_miles = 64 and the TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation included_radius_miles = 40. (3) uniqueness: 64 - 40 = 24; the miles the schedule charges (17) are a pricing count, not the entry's units.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 13.77 = 17 miles charged x ($1.10 - $0.20) x (1 - 10%), rounded once. Factors: per-mile fee $1.10 (delivered purchase merchandise 1,399.99 + 849.99 = 2,249.98, between 2,000.00 and 3,000.00); Plus reduction $0.20 (Club Plus presented; Business Plus $0.30); twelve-month spending 2,249.98 + 414.97 + (1,149.00 + 259.98 - 129.99) = 3,943.94, between 2,500.00 and 5,000.00 -> graduated schedule: first 10 miles in full + 14 further miles as half = 17 (the 2025-09-28 laptop, 1,099.99, is twelve whole months old; counting it reaches 5,043.93 and the capped 10-mile schedule); membership opened 2012-09-20, 168 whole months -> 10 percent tenure discount. Baseline 24 x 1.50 = 36.00.
